Evidence Note 21

A large share of cited web content changes within a few years of publication. The validity of a citation decays silently unless it is re-verified. Citation drift is more dangerous than link rot because nothing visibly breaks. Hashing the normalized body makes the cache immune to advertising noise.

Infrastructure built as a central service disappears when its funding does. The validity of a citation decays silently unless it is re-verified. Preserved versions let anyone recover the text as it was when cited. An honest client reports a refusal exactly as it was received.
